pages.text:
UNITED NATIONS
ECONOMIC AND SOCIAL COUNCIL

NATIONS UNIES
CONSEIL ECONOMIQUE ET SOCIAL

UNRESTRICTED
E/CN.4/53/Corr.1
12 December 1947
FRENCH ONLY.

COMMISSION ON HUMAN RIGHTS

SECOND SESSION

Draft Report on Implementation

------

The following corrections should be made to the French text of document E/CN.4/53:

1. Page 1.

The title should read as follows:

"COMMISSION ON HUMAN RIGHTS

SECOND SESSION

Report of the Working Group entrusted with the study of the problem of implementation

Rapporteur: Mr. Fernand Dehousse (Belgium)"

2. Page 1.

In the fifth line, read problème instead of projet.

3. Page 1.

In the last and the penultimate lines, read: "se sont fait représenter à ses délibérations".

4. Page 8.

In the last line, read: "s'imposait".

5. Page 10.

In the 17th line, read: "l'obligation où ceux-ci".

6. Page 11.

In the 8th line, read: "leurs pays".

E/CN.4/53/Corr.1
Page 2

7. Page 16.

In the 7th line, read "recommandation"

8. Page 20.

In the 9th line, read "refuser".

9. Page 21.

In the 5th line, read "en matière de".

10. Page 21.

In the 10th line, the closing parenthesis comes after the words "par exemple".

11. Page 22.

In the 15th line, read: "quels seront".

12. Page 22.

In the 17th line, read "question"

13. Page 23.

In the 23rd line, read "reçoit".

14. Page 23.

In the 23rd and 24th lines, read: "d'individus, de groupes d'individus, d'associations ou d'Etats".

15. Page 29.

In the 12th line, insert a comma after "Droits de l'Homme".

uncertain.french: lire problème au lieu de projet / "se sont fait représenter à ses délibérations" / "s'imposait" / "l'obligation où ceux-ci" / "leurs pays"
uncertain.issue: The corrections are to the French wording of E/CN.4/53 (single letters underlined on the scan: fait, ses, leurs). The French words themselves are kept untranslated, since translating them would destroy the point of the corrigendum; the underlining is not reproducible in plain text.

uncertain.french: A la 5ème ligne, lire "en matière de".
uncertain.issue: The words "A la 5ème" are smudged on the scan (item 9); "5ème" read with reasonable confidence from the image, OCR gives "5èsâ".

uncertain.french: "recommandation", "refuser", "en matière de", "quels seront", "question", "reçoit", "d'individus, de groupes d'individus, d'associations ou d'Etats"
uncertain.issue: As on page 1, the corrected French words are kept in French; the underlined letters on the scan (recommandation, refuser, de, seront, question, reçoit, d'individus, Etats) cannot be shown in plain text.
